scope: Independent prospective source/code review of the adaptive controller and generated-only analysis path. Operational readiness, not scientific validity.

resolved_findings.issue: Completion originally checked only selected final candidate.
resolved_findings.resolution: Completed finish checks every submitted stage's scheduled seed attempts and success-dependent semantic feedback/analysis. Explicit abandonment retains stage_disposition and is not completion.

resolved_findings.issue: Legacy verifier left trusted worker/launch integrity checks success-only.
resolved_findings.resolution: Controller _verify_execution binds candidate to accepted submission/freeze; scheduled seed/configured limits; full staged request; exact primary input names; allowed input/output inventory; worker hash against session engine commitment; exact launch argv/runtime/worker metadata. These checks apply to failed attempts. Returned and verified recorded receipts must agree. Integrity failure halts and overrides candidate-failure classification.

resolved_findings.issue: Scientific metadata, skills and setup instructions were initially outside session commitments.
resolved_findings.resolution: _inputs snapshots task/request, optional observed file, AUTHOR_TASK.md, SETUP_NOTES.md, adapters.json and all input/ and skills/ files. _load and post-action checks compare bytes and inventory. Candidates remain author-editable until freeze; gateway and source registry use separate controlled history.

checked_properties: Fresh session cannot adopt preexisting frozen candidates or execution/semantic-feedback history.
Append-only source registry and fixed gateway state remain compatible with retrieval after a candidate freeze; arbitrary out-of-action changes are detected.
Submission uses strict semantic_feedback_v1 preflight with frozen sidecar; no legacy fallback.
Host-approved analysis adapter and both transitive estimator files match configured hashes.
Generated analysis accepts only a verified run's generated table plus task/request; inspected estimator receives role='generated' and performs no file access.
Fixed seeds, candidate/seed no-retry and stage lineage are enforced. Failed or unknown-entry executions preserve attempt history.
An entry-confirmed candidate failure may remain actionable only after integrity checks. Pre-entry/unknown-entry infrastructure failures halt before later seed dispatch.
Immutable metadata, skills, instruction bytes and added static-context inventory are checked before and after actions.
All requested lipid estimands and 23 diagnostics are implemented in the inspected generated-only path; same-row/design, unit and contrast scaling are preserved.
Scientific structure, parameters, evidence choice, retrieval timing and retain/revise/stop remain author choices; no target values or fixed model family enter controller.
Finished selection is separated from evaluator-only target comparison; this reviewer opened no target payload or generated clinical table.

focused_tests.provenance: Implementation owner's retained result, reviewed alongside test source. Not rerun by independent reviewer.

related_regression.scope: Owner-reported controller/request-intake/semantic-feedback/literature regression before the final additive static-context patch; final patch covered by 30 focused tests.

validation_evidence.test_boundary: Invented data, intercepted HTTP and mocked program backend. No clinical generator or live source retrieval executed by this reviewer.
validation_evidence.generated_estimator_check: Reviewed test uses artificial orthogonal residuals to check both five-BMI contrasts and residual correlation, plus 23 diagnostics; root reports it passed. No target reference is used.
validation_evidence.runtime_note: Root reports separate existing-runtime availability inspection. This review does not claim an independent live sandbox execution or new isolation proof.

remaining_limits: Hashes and procedural allowlists are not OS isolation of the author or signatures against a malicious host rewriting commitments.
Source semantic agreement is not source extraction, applicability, source-population reconstruction or target validation. Unknown weighting/transforms/definitions remain unavailable.
Initial curated lipid weighting remains unestablished; zero computable source checks is legitimate until actual evidence resolves a definition.
One adaptive author and three seed realizations per stage do not establish a treatment effect, general efficacy, clinical uncertainty or new clinical confirmation.
Budget exhaustion/interruption/explicit abandonment is a retained incomplete terminal disposition, not proof of a successfully evaluated final output.
Any post-review implementation/configuration change requires renewed binding/review before continued execution.
permitted_next_step: Root may create the reviewed session and dispatch author-chosen literature/construction/execution/feedback/analysis actions within the frozen protocol. Newly used source interpretations remain subject to focused independent source review.
